title: Beyond Pairs: Your Language Model is Secretly Optimizing a Preference Graph
abstract: arXiv:2605.08037v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aligns language models using pairwise preference comparisons, offering a simple and effective alternative to Reinforcement Learning (RL) from human feedback. However, in many practical settings, training data consists of multiple rollouts per prompt, inducing rich preference structure that pairwise DPO fails to exploit. Collapsing such data into independent pairs discards transitivity, introduces redundant or conflicting supervision, and can lead to unstable optimization. We propose Graph Direct Preference Optimization (GraphDPO), a structured generalization of DPO that operates over directed acyclic preference graphs induced by rollout rankings. GraphDPO encodes dominance relations as edges and optimizes a graph-structured Plackett--Luce-inspired objective that aggregates supervision over dominated neighborhoods, propagating the transitive structure of the input preferences while recovering

translated_title: 超越成对比较：你的语言模型正在暗中优化一张偏好图
translated_abstract: 直接偏好优化（DPO）通过成对偏好比较来对齐语言模型，为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）提供了一种简单有效的替代方案。然而，在许多实际场景中，训练数据由每个提示的多个 rollout 组成，这蕴含了丰富的偏好结构，而成对 DPO 未能充分利用这些结构。将此类数据压缩为独立配对会丢弃传递性，引入冗余或冲突的监督信号，并可能导致优化不稳定。我们提出了图直接偏好优化（GraphDPO），这是 DPO 的一种结构化推广方法，作用于由 rollout 排名诱导的有向无环偏好图。GraphDPO 将支配关系编码为图中的边，并优化一种受 Plackett-Luce 启发的图结构化目标函数，该函数在 dominated 邻域上聚合监督信号，传播输入偏好的传递结构，同时恢复（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 GraphDPO，将 DPO 从成对偏好比较推广到有向无环偏好图结构，充分利用多个 rollout 之间的传递性偏好关系进行聚合监督，从而实现更稳定、更充分的语言模型对齐。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GraphDPO, a structured generalization of DPO that operates over directed acyclic preference graphs induced by rollout rankings, aggregating supervision over transitive preference structure to achieve more stable language model alignment than pairwise comparisons.
